title: Explosion-Proof Intelligent Inspection Robot Solution
summary: Sevnce pilots an explosion-proof inspection robot. Inspection, cost, and reliability improvements remain projected.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Sevnce pilots an explosion-proof inspection robot. Inspection, cost, and reliability improvements remain projected.
purpose: Inspect hazardous industrial equipment while reducing manual exposure.

ratings.reason: Industrial operators are intended to improve inspection and maintenance, but the quoted improvements are forecasts.
Workers are intended to avoid hazardous inspection tasks; no particular risk exposure or injury outcome is documented.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 5: Explosion-Proof Intelligent Inspection Robot Solution

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: Explosion-proof hardware and multimodal industrial sensors

headline: Inspection robots for hazardous industrial environments
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
